local function merge_sort(values)
    local n = #values
    if n <= 1 then
        return values
    end

    local middle = n // 2
    local left_slice = table.move(values, 1, middle, 1, {})
    local right_slice = table.move(values, middle + 1, n, 1, {})
    local left = merge_sort(left_slice)
    local right = merge_sort(right_slice)
    local merged = {}
    local i = 1
    local j = 1
    local k = 0

    local left_size, right_size = #left, #right
    while i <= left_size and j <= right_size do
        k = k + 1
        if left[i] <= right[j] then
            merged[k] = left[i]
            i = i + 1
        else
            merged[k] = right[j]
            j = j + 1
        end
    end
    table.move(left, i, left_size, k + 1, merged)
    k = k + left_size - i + 1
    table.move(right, j, right_size, k + 1, merged)
    return merged
end

for index = 0, 4095 do

local move = table.move

local function merge_range(values, scratch, first, last)
    if first >= last then return end
    local middle = (first + last) // 2
    merge_range(values, scratch, first, middle)
    merge_range(values, scratch, middle + 1, last)
    move(values, first, last, first, scratch)
    local i, j, out = first, middle + 1, first
    while i <= middle and j <= last do
        if scratch[i] <= scratch[j] then
            values[out] = scratch[i]
            i = i + 1
        else
            values[out] = scratch[j]
            j = j + 1
        end
        out = out + 1
    end
    if i <= middle then move(scratch, i, middle, out, values) end
    if j <= last then move(scratch, j, last, out, values) end
end

local function optimize(f, grad, start, tolerance, max_iterations)
    local c1 = 0.0001
    local rho = 0.5
    local line_search = function(x, direction, fx)
        local step = 1.0
        local gnorm2 = direction[1] * direction[1] + direction[2] * direction[2]
        while true do
            local next = {x[1] + step * direction[1], x[2] + step * direction[2]}
            if f(next) <= fx - c1 * step * gnorm2 then
                return next
            end
            step = step * rho
        end
        return x
    end
    local x = {start[1], start[2]}
    local iterations = 0
    while iterations < max_iterations do
        local g = grad(x)
        local gnorm2 = g[1] * g[1] + g[2] * g[2]
        if gnorm2 < tolerance then
            break
        end
        x = line_search(x, {0.0 - g[1], 0.0 - g[2]}, f(x))
        iterations = iterations + 1
    end
    return iterations
end
